# GOOG Options Analysis — 2026-11-02
**Price: $281.58** | Daily RSI: 15.7 | Weekly RSI: 18.0 | IV Rank: ~95% (HV-based) | ATM IV: 29.4%
200-day MA: $338.70 | 50-day MA: $335.73 | 52W High: $404.47 | 52W Low: $271.41
Pullback from 52W high: -30.4% | Pullback from 3mo high: -26.2% | Distance from 200MA: -16.9%

---

## 1) Strategy Selector

GOOG remains in deep sell-off territory — RSI 15.7 on daily, 18.0 on weekly. Both timeframes are at extreme oversold levels. The stock is 16.9% below its 200-day MA and 30% off its 52-week high. IV Rank is elevated at ~95th percentile (HV-based), meaning realized volatility is near its 52-week high — premium is fat.

**Decision flowchart:**
- **IV environment:** VERY HIGH (~95th percentile HV rank) — peak premium-selling conditions. ATM IV at 29.4% for 18 DTE.
- **Conviction:** High — Alphabet's fundamentals (cloud, AI, search moat) remain intact despite the sell-off.
- **Capital:** ~$26.5K-$27K for CSP at $265-$270 strikes.

**Recommendation:** SELL A CASH-SECURED PUT. IV elevated, RSI at extreme oversold, 30% pullback into 52W low support — textbook CSP setup. LEAPS conditions are developing (4/6) but IV is too expensive to buy long premium. Sell premium now; revisit LEAPS when IV normalizes.

---

## 2) Cash-Secured Put — Entry Conditions

| Condition | Status | Detail |
|-----------|--------|--------|
| IV Rank >= 40% | PASS | ~95th percentile (HV rank) — premium near 52W highs |
| Daily RSI <= 40 | PASS | RSI 15.7 — extreme oversold, deep panic selling |
| Near support | PASS | $271.41 52W low — price only 3.7% above. Major horizontal support zone |
| Premium >= 1.0%/30 DTE | PASS | $268P: $2.69 = 1.0%; $270P: $3.35 = 1.2%; $275P: $4.75 = 1.7% |

**Score: 4/4 — 🟢 GOOD SETUP**

**Strike analysis (Nov 20, 18 DTE):**
- **$280 strike** (0.6% OTM): $6.72 mid = 2.4% yield. Very aggressive — nearly ATM. Eff. basis $273.28.
- **$275 strike** (2.3% OTM): $4.75 mid = 1.7% yield. Eff. basis $270.25. Just below 52W low.
- **$270 strike** (4.1% OTM): $3.35 mid = 1.2% yield. Eff. basis $266.65. Below 52W low.
- **$265 strike** (5.9% OTM): $2.24 mid = 0.85% yield. Eff. basis $262.76. Well below 52W low.
- **$260 strike** (7.7% OTM): $1.51 mid = 0.58% yield. Very conservative.

**Recommended: $270P Nov-20** — $3.35 mid, 1.2% yield for 18 days, effective cost basis $266.65 (1.8% below 52W low). Strong support at $271. Would I own GOOG at $266.65? Absolutely — 34% discount from 52W high for a blue-chip with dominant AI/cloud/search franchise.

---

## 3) Covered Call — Entry Conditions

| Condition | Status | Detail |
|-----------|--------|--------|
| IV Rank >= 40% | PASS | ~95th percentile |
| Daily RSI >= 60 | FAIL | RSI 15.7 — extreme oversold, nowhere near overbought |
| Weekly RSI overbought | FAIL | Weekly RSI 18.0 — deeply oversold |
| Premium >= 0.8% at ~0.20d | FAIL | 0.20d strikes ~$300+, selling at deep loss from any reasonable cost basis |

**Score: 1/4 — 🔴 SKIP**

Do NOT sell covered calls. GOOG is in extreme oversold territory with RSI 15.7/18.0 daily/weekly. Selling calls here caps your recovery upside at the worst possible time. Wait for RSI >= 60 and price stabilization near resistance.

---

## 4) LEAPS Entry Monitor

| Condition | Score | Detail |
|-----------|-------|--------|
| Daily RSI <= 35 | 1 | RSI 15.7 — extreme oversold |
| Weekly RSI stabilizing | 1 | 18.0 — deeply oversold, approaching capitulation inflection |
| Price within 5% support | 1 | 3.7% above 52W low $271.41 |
| IV Rank < 30% | 0 | ~95% — LEAPS premium very expensive right now |
| Options chain liquid | 1 | Sep-2027 $310C: $29.15 mid, OI 241, spread 4.7%. Dec-2027 $310C: $36.73, OI 213 |
| Pullback >= 15% | 1 | 30.4% from 52W high, 26.2% from 3mo high |

**GOOG $281.58 | Score: 5/6 but downgraded to 🟡 MONITORING due to IV cost**

Stock-level conditions nearly perfect but IV Rank at ~95% means LEAPS premium is very expensive. Better play: SELL CSP now to harvest elevated IV. Buy LEAPS when IV drops below 40%.
